description: This file defines a ViewModel class for handling Google Sign-In authentication flow in an Android TV application. It manages sign-in initiation and handling the sign-in result, including token storage and UI update signals.

classes.name: SignInViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that manages the Google Sign-In process, including starting sign-in and handling the result.

methods.name: startGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Initiates the Google Sign-In process by configuring sign-in options and starting the intent.

methods.name: handleSignIn
methods.description: Processes the sign-in result, stores tokens if successful, and updates the sign-in state.
